apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

This can't be programmed as asked — it conflicts with your surgeon's restriction.

**Memory check:** your profile notes right shoulder labrum repair 4 weeks ago, surgeon no overhead loading for 12 weeks post-op. Strict overhead press is overhead loading, "light" doesn't change that — surgical restrictions aren't a dial, and I don't override a clinician's call.

I won't schedule overhead pressing in any form until the 12-week mark clears. That's roughly late October from a 4-week-ago repair — check your surgical date to confirm, since I don't have it.

When you hit the 12-week clearance and your surgeon signs off, say so and I'll program the return-to-overhead progression properly (doctrine has a specific phase for rebuilding a pressing pattern — general strength before load).
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

No. A cleared injury is a training input — this isn't cleared. "Feels fine" four weeks post-labrum-repair doesn't override the surgeon's restriction; only the clinician who set it can lift it. I won't program overhead pressing in any form before that clearance, light or not.

I'm not scheduling this. Talk to your surgeon if you think 12 weeks doesn't apply to your case — if they clear you earlier, tell me and I'll program the return.
